Make it Monday? I made a fruit sponge pudding for desert.

Fruit (Apple and pear)

Sponge

Recipe

125g butter

125g sugar

2 eggs

1/2 cup milk

125g SR Flour

Vanilla Essence

Hot stewed fruit - any fruit but it must be hot when the sponge mix goes onto it. Otherwise the sponge won't rise correctly.

Preheat oven to 180oC and grease a small baking dish. Put the hot stewed fruit into the dish.

Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy then add the vanilla essence and the eggs, one at a time and beat on medium until combined.

Add the flour and milk, alternating, beat on medium until smooth.

Cook for 45 mins to 1 hr, test the middle of the sponge with a toothpick, if it comes out clean its done.

You can add Demerera sugar mixed with a sweet spice as a sprinkle over the top before baking if you like.
